title: dashboard
description: The dashboard summary of the web API (`GET /api/v1/unifi/sites/{site}/dashboard`; there is no command): findings counted by severity and triage state, the headline of the internet connection and Wi-Fi, device and client counts and notable events, with `status`, `complete`, `stale` and `available` so a partial or failed read never reads as healthy.

version.description: The format of this document; it changes only when a field is removed or renamed.

status.description: `critical` or `warning` when a check found it (acknowledged or snoozed findings still count); `ok` only for a complete, fresh read of a controller that answered; `unknown` otherwise. Never `ok` on a partial, old or failed read.

complete.description: False when an optional read failed, so some findings or sections may be missing (see the warnings of the response).

stale.description: True when a read failed and an older cached answer was used instead.

state.description: `ok`: the controller answered; `unreachable`: no answer; `certificate`: its TLS certificate was not accepted; `key_rejected`: it refused the API key.

controller.description: Whether the controller could be read.

site.description: Null when the controller could not be read.

available.description: False: this section was not read (the controller or a read it depends on was unavailable). Every other key of an unavailable section is absent; a missing number is never zero.

by_state.description: Findings by triage state; null when the triage file could not be used (not zero).

attention.description: The open findings to look at first, most urgent first (the order of the findings page).

findings.description: The findings of every check of `diagnose`, counted.

available.description: False: this section was not read (the controller or a read it depends on was unavailable). Every other key of an unavailable section is absent; a missing number is never zero.

other.description: Neither online nor offline: adopting, updating, pending adoption...

available.description: False: this section was not read (the controller or a read it depends on was unavailable). Every other key of an unavailable section is absent; a missing number is never zero.

offline.description: Previously seen clients that are not connected; null when the client history could not be read.

clients.description: Connected clients, and previously seen ones that are not.

available.description: False: this section was not read (the controller or a read it depends on was unavailable). Every other key of an unavailable section is absent; a missing number is never zero.

availability_pct.description: The lowest 24-hour availability the controller reports across the WAN connections.

wan.description: The headline of the internet connection (`wan`).

available.description: False: this section was not read (the controller or a read it depends on was unavailable). Every other key of an unavailable section is absent; a missing number is never zero.

wifi.description: The headline of the Wi-Fi radios (`wifi`), over the access points that are online.

available.description: False: this section was not read (the controller or a read it depends on was unavailable). Every other key of an unavailable section is absent; a missing number is never zero.

notable_total.description: Events above low severity in the window.

notable.description: The newest of those, at most five.

events.description: Events of the last 24 hours (the one read-only event log query).
